audit_items.proof_trace: The withdraw entry point does not accept an Obligation parameter at all; it only accepts ObligationOwnerCap and uses cap.obligation_id (returned by the public id() accessor) as the key to look up the obligation via self.obligations.borrow_mut(obligation_id) in handle_withdraw (market.move L321). Since ObjectTable borrow_mut uses the supplied ID as the lookup key, the fetched obligation's ID equals cap.obligation_id by construction. The cap's obligation_id field is set at creation (new(), package-scoped) and has no mutating accessor, so no mismatch is structurally possible.
